question: What happens to the fuel in a vehicle left in the sun?

options.text: It decomposes into water and carbon dioxide

solution:
The correct answer is __It evaporates from the tank**(Option 4)**.__

**__Key Points__**

__
 
• Fuel evaporation__ is a common phenomenon when a vehicle is left in the sun.
 
• High temperatures cause fuel molecules to vaporize.
 
• This leads to a loss of fuel from the tank.
 
• Evaporation reduces fuel efficiency and may increase emissions.
 
• Modern vehicles use systems to minimize evaporation and control emissions.

**__Additional Information__**

 
• **Effects of Heat on Fuel:**
 
 
• Heat accelerates fuel evaporation, leading to loss and inefficiency.
 
• Proper vehicle maintenance can reduce these effects.
 
 
 
• **Impact on Environment:**
 
 
• Evaporated fuel contributes to air pollution and greenhouse gases.
 
• Using well-maintained fuel systems can help mitigate this.
 
 
 
• **Preventive Measures:**
 
 
• Park vehicles in shaded areas to reduce fuel evaporation.
 
• Consider using fuel additives to maintain efficiency.
